about.title: About Me
about.bio: A part-time AI master’s student in the 2025 cohort at Fudan University’s College of Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence, with a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science and Technology from Dalian Minzu University. I have 6+ years of software engineering and architecture experience across backend services, microservices, media transcoding, segmentation, and CDN delivery. I received multiple awards in international underwater robotics and China robotics competitions. I am currently developing an AgentOS project for robotics applications and exploring multimodal perception, task planning, and execution feedback.
